other_conditions: Must be a native of Madhya Pradesh.
Must be a registered construction worker or a family member registered under the MP Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
For Category‑A awards, must submit a certificate issued by the District Superintendent of Police or the District Sports Officer through a recognized sports organization.
benefits_summary: Financial incentives ranging from ₹5,000 to ₹30,000 are paid to eligible construction workers or their families who win at district, division or state level sports competitions.
documents_required: Certificate issued by the District Superintendent of Police or the District Sports Officer through a recognized sports organization
